core_obligations: If each alpha_i is separable over K_{i-1} then deg_s(P_i) = deg(P_i) = [K_i : K_{i-1}], so multiplicativity and the explicit embedding count give [K : F] = product deg(P_i) = product deg_s(P_i) = |Mor_F(K, F-bar)|
If some alpha_i is not separable over K_{i-1}, the identical chain of equalities and inequalities gives |Mor_F(K, F-bar)| < [K : F]

Separability of K/F: for arbitrary gamma in K regenerate the tower as (gamma, alpha_1, ..., alpha_n); if gamma were not separable over F the already-proven strict inequality would contradict the already-proven equality for the original tower
proof_roadmap: Compute the embedding count through the separable degrees step by step
Derive the strict inequality for towers with an inseparable step
Prove separability of K/F by reordering the tower with gamma first
